description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code that handles date validation for 'fromDate' and 'thruDate' input fields. It initializes event handlers upon document readiness, retrieves localized labels, and checks that the 'fromDate' is earlier than the 'thruDate', displaying an error message if not.

methods.name: checkDate
methods.description: Validates that 'fromDate' is earlier than 'thruDate' and displays an error message if the validation fails.
